detail.title: Predictive Limitations of Physical Frameworks in Autonomous Agents
detail.question: What are the limitations of classical and quantum physical frameworks in modeling the behavior of autonomous agents in highly non-stationary environments?
detail.reason: The supplied evidence (source-116d9e85a17f47be) explicitly identifies structural incompatibilities and predictive failures when applying standard physical models to intentional, adaptive agents, warranting a formal research project.
